## Invitations

A total of 1443 invitations were issued during the outreach activity. Attendance was 225, giving an overall attendance rate of 15.6 per cent. The invitation process supported engagement across the River Districts and provided residents with an opportunity to access the service in a location and format suitable to local circumstances.

Van days were maintained where roads allowed. This helped preserve access for communities affected by local road conditions and supported delivery of the planned outreach activity. The approach was kept under review so that available arrangements could be used effectively during the reporting period.

## Contact

SMS contact was used alongside the invitations, with 1251 invitations sent by SMS. A reminder message was also sent to 1251 people. These contact arrangements were intended to reinforce awareness of the activity and encourage attendance. The combination of initial SMS contact and reminder messaging provided a consistent follow-up process for those invited.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
